{{Quote|Tell me, Cade, have you ever met a Neti?''"<br />"''Hard to meet a myth, Shado.|[[Shado Vao]] and [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="L25:THT1">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>}}
The '''Neti''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]]<ref name="SW34:D3" /><ref name="T'ra Saa WC" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="PotJS" /><ref name="TEGAS" /> [[Plant/Legends|plants]]<ref name="L-W6" /> from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]], though they were first encountered on their colony [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Ryyk]]. Some called them '''Ryyk''' because of the planet's name. Notable Neti included the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Garnoo]], [[Ood Bnar]], [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Librarian/Legends|librarian]] [[Dail'Liss]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|The gatekeeper of this teaching device is of a race of beings that evolved from the trees on the planet Myrkr.|Thon speaks of Ood Bnar|<ref name="TotJ5:TSoNS3" />}}
The Neti were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]]<ref name="SW34:D3" /><ref name="T'ra Saa WC" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="PotJS" /><ref name="TEGAS" /> [[Plant/Legends|plants]]<ref name="L-W6" /> who generally stood between 2 to 5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="TEGAS" /> but a skilled individual could morph into a roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped solid [[Tree/Legends|treelike]] mass anywhere from 2 to 9.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="PotJS" /> They evolved from the [[Unidentified tree (Myrkr)|trees]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].<ref name="TotJ5:TSoNS3" />

[[File:Transformation_of_ood.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ood Bnar]] shapeshifting.]]
The Neti had tough gray skin similar to [[Plant/Legends|plant]] bark, multiple thin branching arms, and thick body trunks. Neti foliage tended to be brownish or black and grew on the upper parts of a Neti's body. As plants, Neti survived through [[Photosynthesis/Legends|photosynthesis]], though they also needed some [[Water/Legends|water]] to survive. Neti were extremely long-lived, with an average life span of several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Neti [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]] only occurred once every few [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Seeds often remained dormant for more than a thousand years before germinating.<ref name="PotJS" />

Neti were capable of changing their size and shape, apparently at will. The shapes and sizes a Neti could assume ranged from very humanoid to very treelike, even when asleep or knocked unconscious. When resting, they generally appeared as 5-meter-tall treelike objects. As a result of the Neti's infrequent procreation and long lives, their population always remained small and quite close to their homeworld.<ref name="PotJS" />

[[File:TraSaasDescendants.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Neti [[T'ra Saa's descendants|saplings]] born from [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] on Taivas.]]
As plants, Neti had no need for food. They had a greatly reduced need for water as long as they had regular access to broad-[[spectrum]] light. Neti only had need of one-tenth the water of most other species, but if deprived of sunlight, they would starve, much as other races would when lacking food. Neti schooled in a special Force trance, presumably [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trance]], could survive almost indefinitely in an area without natural sunlight and rain.<ref name="PotJS" /> All Neti were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
Neti never were a common sight across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When Ryyk was destroyed, only one Neti ([[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]]) was known to have been offworld. However, given the species' long life span and germination period, some Neti might have survived the destruction of their world, awaiting discovery in remote locations.<ref name="PotJS" />

It was known that a [[Unidentified Neti clan|clan]] of Neti continued to live on [[Nerit]], a temperate moon of the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> By the [[Legacy era|era]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the species was considered a myth.<ref name="L25:THT1" />
